title: Align UI comparison rendering
objective: Ensure matrix cell, tooltip, and row summary show not synced when Millware regular data is missing for Sunday/holiday.
steps: Update tooltip/comparison render path so OFF is not treated as no-regular-required.
Confirm getSyncStatus uses the same rule for presence, overtime, and all modes.
Remove or gate temporary POM00214 debug logs after behavior is covered.
Preserve existing UI colors and density.
acceptance: UI red/not_synced when comparisonData has no record or hasRegularRecord false for OFF/LBR.
Summary miss counts include missing Sunday/holiday regular data.
